title: Machine learning guides screening of redox perovskites for solar hydrogen
summary: Random-forest models predicted oxygen-vacancy enthalpy and screened stability across candidate redox perovskites; four selected materials were synthesized and tested thermochemically. The paper’s solar-hydrogen system outcomes are simulations, not a demonstrated plant. The full article was available only as publisher-indexed primary text in this review.
ai_technology: Random-forest vacancy-enthalpy model and stability classifier

evidence.tested: Publisher indexed primary text confirms model screens and synthesis/thermochemical experiments on four compositions.
evidence.unknown: Direct full article and supplement were blocked; full experimental yields, prior composition art, and independent replication not audited.
evidence.ai_role: ML screening of vacancy enthalpy and stability narrowed computational candidates for synthesis and thermochemical testing.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
